```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)

household <- read.csv("/Users/bryce/Downloads/Career/Stats Projects/CSV_data_files/faps_household_puf.csv")
```


## 
```{r}
childcare <- household |>
  select(foodsufficient,expchildcare_r,famsize,adltfscat,foodsecureq2) |>
  filter(
    !foodsufficient %in% c(-998,-997,-996),
    !expchildcare_r %in% c(-998,-997,-997))

childcare <- childcare |>
  mutate(ccexp_norm = expchildcare_r/famsize)

summary(childcare$ccexp_norm)
summary(childcare$expchildcare_r)

childcare2 <- childcare |>
  filter(expchildcare_r>0)

summary(childcare2$ccexp_norm)
summary(childcare2$expchildcare_r)

childcare3 <- childcare |>
  filter(expchildcare_r==0)

summary(lm(foodsecureq2 ~ ccexp_norm, data=childcare))
summary(lm(foodsecureq2 ~ ccexp_norm, data=childcare2))

childcare4 <- childcare |>
  mutate(pays_childcare = expchildcare_r >0)

chisq.test(table(childcare4$pays_childcare, childcare4$foodsecureq2))
table(childcare4$pays_childcare, childcare4$foodsecureq2)
```
# Plots
```{r}
childcare$spends_cc <- ifelse(childcare$expchildcare_r >0, "Spends on childcare","Does not spend on childcare")

ggplot(childcare, aes(x=spends_cc, fill=spends_cc)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Childcare Spending Among Households",
    x="Childcare Spending",
    y = "Count"
  ) + 
  geom_text(stat="count",aes(label=after_stat(count)),vjust=-0.5,size=4)+
  scale_fill_manual(values=c("Does not spend on childcare"="steelblue", "Spends on childcare" = "tomato")) +
  theme_minimal()

childcare |>
  filter(expchildcare_r > 0) |>
  mutate(ccexp_bins = cut(ccexp_norm, breaks = 6)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = ccexp_bins)) +
  geom_bar(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Childcare Spending Among Families Who Spend on Childcare",
    x = "Normalized Childcare Expenditure",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

## Linear Regressions
combined <- bind_rows(
  all_households <- childcare |>
    select(ccexp_norm, foodsecureq2) |> 
    mutate(dataset = "childcare"),
   childcare_spending_households <- childcare2 |> 
    select(ccexp_norm, foodsecureq2) |> 
    mutate(dataset = "childcare2")
) |>
  mutate(
    ccexp_bin    = cut(ccexp_norm, breaks = 6, dig.lab = 3),
    foodsecureq2 = factor(foodsecureq2,
                          levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                          labels = c("Food insecure",
                                     "Marginal insecurity",
                                     "Food secure"))
  )

ggplot(combined, aes(x = ccexp_bin, fill = foodsecureq2)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill", color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  facet_wrap(~dataset, ncol = 1,
           labeller = labeller(dataset = c(
             "childcare"  = "All Households",
             "childcare2" = "Households with Childcare Spending"
           ))) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Food secure"         = "#5DCAA5",
    "Marginal insecurity" = "#FAC775",
    "Food insecure"       = "#D85A30")) +
  labs(
    x    = "Normalized Chilcare Expenses",
    y    = "Proportion",
    fill = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x      = element_text(angle = 35, hjust = 1),
    legend.position  = "top",
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank())
```
## Logistic Regression
```{r}
childcare <- childcare |>
  mutate(foodsecureq2 = factor(foodsecureq2,
                                levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                                labels = c("Food insecure",
                                           "Marginally insecure",
                                           "Food secure"),
                                ordered = TRUE))

childcare2 <- childcare2 |>
  mutate(foodsecureq2 = factor(foodsecureq2,
                                levels = c(1, 2, 3),
                                labels = c("Food insecure",
                                           "Marginally insecure",
                                           "Food secure"),
                                ordered = TRUE))

summary(polr(foodsecureq2 ~ ccexp_norm, data = childcare,  Hess = TRUE))
summary(polr(foodsecureq2 ~ ccexp_norm, data = childcare2, Hess = TRUE))

m <- polr(foodsecureq2 ~ ccexp_norm, data = childcare, Hess = TRUE)
ctable <- coef(summary(m))

p <- pnorm(abs(ctable[, "t value"]), lower.tail = FALSE) * 2
cbind(ctable, "p value" = round(p, 4))
```
